lessons.finding: Spruce item pages are teammate paging records and voice/video event success is not fax success. Public v1 proves posting, not terminal fax transmission. Shared directly with SRFax and Documo teams; both applied explicit provider-specific status/page validation.

An accepted PDF upload is one approved operation. A fax using that PDF requires a separate exact approval, unchanged reviewed source and the same account. Imported the SRFax team's early required-routing validation lesson and applied it to the documented Spruce setup prerequisites.

Each mutation is claimed once. A lost upload or send response remains unconfirmed, and an unrelated or contradictory signed event cannot manufacture acceptance. A lost status response can recover via a fresh explicit read without repeating the fax. Spruce's recovered pending item does not erase prior aggregate unknown transport evidence; unlike a terminal fax receipt, it proves only posting. This recovery pattern was exchanged with SRFax and Documo.

The Documo team identified that a sending key may lack status-read authority. Spruce similarly needs more than API access: the reviewed fax endpoint and signed callback setup must exist before its accepted request can be reconciled to a posted item. Neither configuration nor synthetic acceptance proves live delivery.
